fusions.name: Rehearsed Shot
fusions.desc: Looses a shot at the first enemy in line that deals 4 damage. Against an enemy that has not yet been hurt, its critical chance rises by 40%.

fusions.name: Measured Mile
fusions.desc: A long shot that deals 24 damage, rising to 2.4 times that at its full reach of 9 tiles. It is always a critical hit.

fusions.name: Pick Up the Trail
fusions.desc: Clears the cooldown on one of your other abilities, chosen at random from those still waiting. Your movement speed rises 20% for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Each One Cleaner
fusions.desc: Every time you kill an enemy, a stack builds on you, up to 5. The next ability you use spends them all: you deal 5% more damage per stack (24% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
